title: PrivateBrowserAgentAdapter
responsibility: Expose only status, private-entry request and a reviewed read to one kernel-verified agent UID.

inputs.name: PrivateBrowserAgentAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: Executor-owned socket, pinned agent UID and peer lookup, the gate, a paired device and reviewed field delivery, and one allowlisted read.

outputs.name: PrivateBrowserAgentAdapter.listen
outputs.description: Starts the owner-controlled Unix listener and grants socket access only to its configured group.

outputs.name: PrivateBrowserAgentAdapter.close
outputs.description: Stops the listener and destroys its connections. A failed bind leaves another server’s socket alone.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: An invalid socket path or agent UID, or a socket whose permissions cannot be restricted.
